record.question: Which of the following has been declared as the third administrative division of Jammu and Kashmir?
record.explanation: Answer B: Ladakh. Ladakh was declared the third administrative division of the then State of Jammu and Kashmir on 8 February 2019. The Ladakh administration’s history records that event. Leh was a constituent district rather than the new division’s name. Historical/source note: Status at the April 2019 examination. Ladakh became a separate Union Territory on 31 October 2019; that later change is not projected backward. Reference: https://ladakh.gov.in/housing-and-urban-development/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
